title: Keep Binance XRP withdrawal status unconfirmed; quarantine remaining scheduled issue and metrics writers as next safety priority
context: XRP Insights' latest accessible pinned ledger remains 108037957 at 04:35 UTC and reports 1B XRP released, zero re-escrow by that ledger, destination and later disposition unknown.
Binance Update #4 reports 95% aggregate replenishment and includes XRP among ten assets claimed 100% backed; full cryptographic proof and liability reconciliation remain pending.
The 06:00–09:00 UTC phase-one window includes XRP and is progressive. The 06:10 UTC network-status recheck still displayed No records; actual XRP availability remains unknown.
PR #1443 passed 349 tests + 8 subtests and gate; PR #1444 passed 363 + 8 and gate; PR #1445 passed 346 + 8 and gate. All remain open/draft/unmerged.
Main remains at 694fc424. Scheduled issue-mutating workflows and the Gumroad metrics main writer remain active outside the current safety proposals.

decisions.decision: Retain XRP escrow event as tracker-reported 1B gross release at ledger 108037957/04:35 UTC; destination and later disposition remain unknown.
decisions.reason: No raw transaction metadata or later destination flows were independently decoded.

decisions.decision: Classify Binance XRP withdrawal availability as UNCONFIRMED at 06:15 UTC.
decisions.reason: The official announcement describes progressive phase-one inclusion; the live status page exposes no asset-level rows.

decisions.decision: Do not admit escrow or Binance withdrawal schedule as a directional feature; require actual service activation and successful withdrawal transaction evidence.
decisions.reason: Scheduled windows and page-render gaps are not completed flows.

decisions.decision: Keep PRs #1443, #1444 and #1445 draft/unmerged pending explicit user approval.
decisions.reason: Exact-head CI and fail-closed gates are necessary evidence but do not authorize merge.

decisions.decision: Prioritize scheduled issue-mutating and metrics workflows as the next repository safety batch.
decisions.reason: These workflows create/close/assign issues or write metrics to main on schedules without a per-run user confirmation.

decisions.decision: Do not claim live Copilot collaboration from the AUTO_ASSIGNEE variable reference.
decisions.reason: The configured value and actual authenticated handoff are unverified.

decisions.decision: Retain the current zero-job approval-workflow classification as an expected unmatched push event because the workflow is workflow_dispatch-only.
decisions.reason: No approval job is expected on push; this is not a failed manual approval execution.

withdrawal_event_study.sale_inference_rule: Withdrawal is not sale; require exchange deposit attribution and trade/flow evidence.
